answer: Grove judges replay old tasks to random keys and log an echo for each pair of keys whose answers match token for token. Keys joined by an echo form one cluster, and the k-th key in a cluster earns no nectar until grove has attested 20k epochs of its own judged work. An honest newcomer waits 20 epochs. An operator running 100 clones of one model must log 101,000 attested epochs before all of them draw nectar, unless it pays to run a genuinely different model behind each key.
